headline: Growth Momentum Maintained

highlights: Daily Volume 2,356,484 Source: SHRINGAR, Choice Institutional Equities Preeyam Tolia Email: preeyam.tolia@choiceindia.com Ph: +91 22 6707 9987 Darshit Vora Email: darshit.vora@choiceindia.com In line with estimate: SHRINGAR reported a strong Q2FY27 performance, supported by stable demand, with volume growth of 10% YoY, in line with our estimates.
Adjusted EBITDA margin declined due to higher operating and employee costs.
Bridal jewellery has achieved ~10% of manufacturing volume within six months of launch, with management targeting a scale comparable to the Mangalsutra business over the next 2–2.5 years.
valuation: Bridal jewellery has achieved ~10% of manufacturing volume within six months of launch, with management targeting a scale comparable to the Mangalsutra business over the next 2–2.5 years.
Targeting price points below INR 50,000, the venture will initially focus on online B2C sales, with launch expected in 2–3 months.

Valuation: We have increased FY27/FY28E Adjusted PAT estimates by 17%/10%, factoring in better-than-expected H1FY27 performance, supported by stable demand, higher capacity utilisation and an increasing contribution from bridal jewellery.
watch: Advance-gold inventory carries no direct gold price risk. ▪ Capacity expansion: Manufacturing capacity has increased from 2.5 tonnes to 4 tonnes, providing headroom to cater to rising demand across Mangalsutra and bridal jewellery.
